name: custtoolset_pillar8_extractor
description: Extracts operational scale metrics and historical data growth trends to enable Generative AI predictive risk modeling and contextual recommendations.

analysisType.description: The specific context or trend metric to extract. Use 'operational_scale' to understand the organization's size (users, subsidiaries), or 'database_growth_trends' to get the month-over-month velocity of System Notes and Transactions.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing organizational scale counters or time-series arrays representing database generation velocity.
